import html # The base HTML template containing a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe Output
{user_content}
""" def construct_html_response(content: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML response by escaping user-provided content and injecting it into the html_template. Parameters: content (str): The dynamic content supplied by the user. Returns: str: A complete HTML string with the escaped user content. """ # Escape special characters to prevent injection (CWE-74) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Inject the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
